material_scope: Unique material names per model; materials within a spawned instance may be intentionally shared by matching semantic region. Runtime must clone material objects per instance before tint changes.
tint_semantics: baseColorFactor multiplies preserved base-color textures; untextured material factors directly set surface color.

slots.name: wall_segment__dark
slots.editing: GLB pbrMetallicRoughness.baseColorFactor; Blender PALETTE_TINT multiplier when textured, Principled Base Color when untextured

slots.name: wall_segment__stone
slots.editing: GLB pbrMetallicRoughness.baseColorFactor; Blender PALETTE_TINT multiplier when textured, Principled Base Color when untextured

map_policy: Original basecolor, roughness, normal, AO and glazing emission channels retained where originally supplied.
lod_tint_transfer: Carry a semantic tint multiplier across LODs, not a raw factor. For each mapped slot, RGB = that LOD slot default RGB × chosen semantic tint RGB; keep original alpha. This preserves different authored base defaults.

wall_surface.description: Stone masonry/coping surface; common tint channel across all LODs.

mortar_detail_lod0_only.description: LOD0 separate dark mortar core. At lower LODs the original 512px masonry atlas includes mortar within the masonry material; it cannot be independently recolored without a new mask. Use wall_surface for consistent whole-wall tint.

lod_limitation: Original optimized wall LOD1/2 combine masonry and mortar in one preserved atlas; independent mortar recolor is only available at LOD0. No claim of exact per-region RGB transfer across these different materials.
